text: Gradient descent updates model parameters by stepping against the gradient of the loss.
Backpropagation computes gradients of the loss with respect to every weight in a neural network.
BM25 is a ranking function that scores documents by term frequency, inverse document frequency and length.
Dense retrieval encodes queries and passages into vectors and ranks passages by similarity.
Reciprocal rank fusion merges several ranked lists by summing one over rank plus a constant.
A bloom filter is a compact probabilistic set that can return false positives but never false negatives.
Cross validation splits data into folds so a model is always scored on examples it has not seen.
Overfitting happens when a model memorises training noise and performs worse on new data.
A feature store serves the same engineered features for training and for online prediction.
Concept drift is a change in the relationship between inputs and targets after deployment.
Prediction intervals describe the range in which a future observation is expected to fall.
Retrieval augmented generation grounds a language model answer in passages fetched at query time.
